task: In the reliary-sift crate, change the minimum hex hash length in the `skeleton()` function from 7 to 8. The function is in crates/reliary-sift/src/classify.rs. Only change the number 7 to 8 in the hex hash length check.

Add a MAC address placeholder `{mac}` to the `skeleton()` function in crates/reliary-sift/src/classify.rs. MAC addresses have the format XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX where XX are hex digits. Place the detection BEFORE the hex hash check (rule 3). When a MAC address is detected, emit `{mac}` and skip past it.

Add a new `Annotation` variant to the `LineType` enum in crates/reliary-sift/src/lib.rs. Then update `classify_line()` to detect annotation lines: lines starting with `# @` (like `# @deprecated`, `# @author`) should return `LineType::Annotation`. Place this check BEFORE the generic Comment check.

In crates/reliary-sift/src/lib.rs, change the `classify_line()` function so that the Summary check runs BEFORE the Error check. Currently Error is checked first (lines ~212-214), then Summary (lines ~217-223). Swap the order so Summary is checked first. This means a line like '3 passed, 2 failed, error in module' should return Summary, not Error.

Extract the UUID detection logic from `skeleton()` in crates/reliary-sift/src/classify.rs into a new public function `normalize_uuid(input: &str) -> Option<String>`. The function should return `Some("{uuid}")` if the input is a valid UUID (8-4-4-4-12 hex format with dashes at positions 8,13,18,23), or `None` otherwise. Then update `skeleton()` to call `normalize_uuid()` instead of inlining the UUID check. Make sure `normalize_uuid` is pub.

Add a 4th gate to MaxwellGate in crates/reliary-sift/src/lib.rs. Currently it has entropy_threshold, compression_ratio_max, diversity_min. Add a new field `lexical_density_min: f64` (with default 0.15). Then in the `score()` method, add a 4th check after the existing 3: if `lexical_diversity < lexical_density_min`, return None. Wait — there's already a diversity check. Instead, add a LENGTH-based 4th gate: add field `max_line_repetition: usize` (default 10). Count the max repetition of any single line in the text. If any line repeats more than max_line_repetition times, return None.

Add IPv6 address detection to `skeleton()` in crates/reliary-sift/src/classify.rs. IPv6 addresses contain hex digits and colons, like `fe80::1` or `2001:db8::1` or `::1`. When detected, emit `{ipv6}`. Place this check AFTER the UUID check but BEFORE the hex hash check. An IPv6 address has 2+ colons and at least one hex digit. Be careful not to match timestamps (which have a single colon).

Update the `compress_content()` function in crates/reliary-sift/src/lib.rs to handle the `Annotation` line type. Currently it handles Blank, Import, Comment, Error, Summary, Definition, Code. Add handling for Annotation: Annotation lines should be KEPT (not collapsed), similar to how Error and Definition lines are kept. If you also added the Annotation variant to LineType (from edit task 3), make sure compress_content preserves Annotation lines in the output.

Rename the `skeleton()` function to `normalize()` in crates/reliary-sift/src/classify.rs. Also update ALL callers: `skeleton_hash()` calls `skeleton()`, and any other functions that reference it. The function signature should stay the same, just the name changes from `skeleton` to `normalize`. Make sure the code still compiles.

In crates/reliary-sift/src/classify.rs, the `aggressive_skeleton()` function currently keeps single-letter words verbatim (line ~308: `if we - i == 1`). Change this to keep 2-letter words verbatim as well. So `we - i <= 2` should keep the word verbatim instead of collapsing to `{w}`. This means words like 'ab', 'cd', 'to' should stay as-is, while 'abc' and longer get collapsed to `{w}`.
